# Pratham Arora - Research Notebook & Technical Portfolio

> "I keep building small, self-tested tools to remove friction from tasks I do myself - and now that AI sits inside almost everything I build or am evaluated with, I want to study what that presence does to a person's actual skill and their trust in it."

## Research Focus Areas

### 1. Human-AI Interaction Under Time and Trust Pressure
- Investigating how feedback modalities (embodied non-verbal cues vs. visual HUD spinners vs. verbal fillers) affect user patience, animacy attribution, and immersion during system wait states.
- Empirical within-subjects experiment ($N=18$) demonstrated that embodied gestures statistically outperform visual spinners ($p < 0.05$, Wilcoxon signed-rank), shifting user attribution from "system lag" to "cognitive reflection".
- Paper: *Wait for It: A Component-Level Analysis of Latency Feedback Mechanisms for LLM Agents in VR* (Under review, MIT Presence, 2026).

### 2. Characterizing How Models Fail (Physical-World Reasoning)
- Empirical benchmark of 459 tabletop images with instrument-verified ground truth (digital scale, caliper measurements) across 5 physical estimation tasks (mass, height, volume, material density, center-of-mass).
- Uncovered the *misidentification-vs-miscalibration dichotomy*: GPT-5.4 fails at object/material identification (confusing steel with plastic), whereas Gemini variants identify objects correctly but overestimate mass by 1.8x–2.5x due to uncalibrated numerical scale.
- Documented "pixel-coverage cheating": models derive height and volume from bounding-box pixel percentages rather than true 3D perspective geometry. Optical blur collapses physical reasoning across all frontier models.
- Paper: *QUIVER: Benchmarking and Enhancing Physical Reasoning Abilities of Vision-Language Models* (Submitted to AAAI 2027).

### 3. Production Systems & Friction-Reduction Tooling
- Built an AST-fingerprinted retrieval system for Cotality, hashing function-level abstract syntax trees to cut Azure OpenAI embedding API costs by 85% across 50,000+ LOC/day polyglot codebases. Migrated from in-memory FAISS to Azure Cosmos DB with IVF vector indexing for durable multi-tenant persistence.
- Built self-tested friction-reduction tools:
 - Court-side basketball scoring app: touch-first interface designed for fast-break ergonomics.
 - Athleda auction slide generator: client-side XLSX parsing, ZIP extraction, and vector PPTX export (`pptxgenjs`) with zero server overhead.
 - Sem-7 timetable clash-checker: interactive multi-semester conflict visualizer adopted cohort-wide at Plaksha.
 - VLM physical data annotation app: combined photography with ground-truth instrument logging on mobile.
